title: Destiny's Advancements
description: Adds a few more advancements to existing categories and new ones. Supported in client and server (it may not show that though)
body:
This datapack makes an advancement out of anything so that you can be busy in the late game.
Advancements range from reallyyy common to reallyyy rare, so good luck!

Added Categories consist of 
- Combat
- Aquatic
- Redstone
- Transport

Total advancements are  45 and
41 in new categories
and 4 in existing ones

Also this datapack will be updated to 1.21 in a week or so
